excerpt: The Fed held the fed funds rate steady and made minor changes to its policy statement during the April 28-29, 2026 FOMC meeting. The economic outlook remained unchanged, and energy prices stayed elevated. The meeting minutes were released on April 29, 2026.

A joint meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee and the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System was held in the offices of the Board of Governors on Tuesday, April 28, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. and continued on Wednesday, April 29, 2026, at 9:00 a.m.[1](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcminutes20260429.htm#fn1 "footnote 1")[](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcminutes20260429.htm). Alyssa Arute,[3](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcminutes20260429.htm#fn3 "footnote 3")[](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcminutes20260429.htm) Assistant Director, Division of Reserve Bank Operations and Payment Systems, Board. Kurt Kostyu,[8](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcminutes20260429.htm#fn8 "footnote 8")[](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcminutes20260429.htm) Capital Markets Trading Principal, Federal Reserve Bank of New York.
